name: stance
title: Stance
description: A source's stance towards the Wheel of Heaven reading. Set per-source.

values.label: Supportive
values.description: The source advances claims compatible with or directly supportive of the canon.

values.label: Neutral
values.description: The source neither argues for nor against the canon's framing.

values.label: Critical
values.description: The source argues against, complicates, or rebuts claims relevant to the canon.

values.label: Mixed
values.description: The source supports the canon on some points and critiques on others.
